description: A U.S. 501(c)(3) nonprofit providing after-school digital literacy and STEM mentoring to low-income teenagers. It seeks grant funding to expand an established teaching program and purchase laptops. It does not develop AI products.

A woman-founded U.S. for-profit startup developing an AI assistant for small farms in Texas. It has a working MVP and two pilots, is pre-seed, and seeks product development funding. The founder lives in the U.S., owns 70%, and works full time. The company has operated for 14 months, earns $80000 annually, has a business bank account and $1200 revenue on its recent statement.

A Kenyan nonprofit building an open-source machine learning platform for disaster response and aid logistics. It has a working prototype tested with two aid organizations and seeks funding for a larger pilot. It has no U.S. incorporation and no published evidence of large-scale impact yet.

A U.S. 501(c)(3) nonprofit supporting families facing eviction through casework and emergency assistance. It seeks cash grants for direct services. It has five years of service outcomes but no technology product or AI project.

A woman-led deep-tech for-profit incorporated in Armenia developing energy-efficient water purification hardware. It has a tested laboratory prototype, has operated for 24 months, and seeks non-dilutive R&D funding. Women hold 60% ownership and the founder works in top management. It does not use AI.

A U.S. university research team developing generative AI tools for scientific discovery in biology. It seeks research funding to validate a prototype. The team is not incorporated as a small business, and its work is not a commercial product or government service.

An Indian social enterprise providing affordable mental health support to rural women. It is a for-profit venture with a working service prototype and seeks pilot funding in India. It uses phone counseling rather than an AI product. Founder ownership, company age and revenue have not been supplied.

A U.S. 501(c)(3) tech nonprofit building open-source civic tools that help residents understand local government budgets. It has a working MVP and an established community pilot. It seeks funding to expand civic participation and public accountability. It does not currently use generative AI.
